name: CompareCamp

sources.title: Request a Review page (site nav link confirmed via search index) — direct fetch returned HTTP 403
CompareCamp editorial (search-indexed) — 'You can attract software buyers by requesting a product review on Comparecamp'
Third-party listing guide — CompareCamp covers SaaS reviews/comparisons; listings can be claimed; relevant to software businesses in specific industries

conditions: The public route is 'Request a Review' — an editorial review request, not a guaranteed listing; acceptance and timing are at the editorial team's discretion
CompareCamp is part of the FinancesOnline group of software review sites — paid marketing packages and lead-gen campaigns are the monetization; basic editorial listing is free but not guaranteed
requirements: A SaaS/software product that fits their reviewed categories (project management, CRM, accounting, HR, marketing, etc.)
Willingness to have the product editorially reviewed — pros AND cons are published; the review is not vendor-controlled
Complete product info for the request: what it does, target users, pricing
preparation: Product name, URL, category fit, description, pricing model
Differentiators and a demo/access path for the review team if requested
Awareness that the sister site FinancesOnline sells premium review/lead packages — decide upfront whether free editorial coverage is the goal
workflow: Open https://comparecamp.com/request-a-review/ in a browser (site 403s automated fetches)
Submit the product details via the request form
The editorial team decides whether to review; respond to follow-up questions/access requests
If published, the product gets a review page and appears in category comparisons; claim/manage the listing where supported
watchFor: Site blocks automated fetches (403) — verify the form in a browser
Editorial review means honest pros/cons — there is no approval over the published verdict
Expect lead-gen upsell offers (premium marketing packages, awards programs) tied to the FinancesOnline network
No guarantee or timeline for review publication
countsAsLive: A published review/profile page for the product exists on comparecamp.com and appears in its software-category listing
unknowns: Whether un-reviewed products can get a bare listing without editorial review
Outbound link treatment on published profiles
